SL-008 is implemented and committed as `d49e35f`. `npm test` passes (24 of 24) and `npm run typecheck` is clean. - **Ordering:** `listTasks` in `src/tasks.ts` now sorts by `created_at DESC, id DESC`. When two tasks share the same instant, the one saved last comes first. The database layer is untouched, as the slice requires. - **Empty state:** `public/index.html` has a `

`, as the page contract specifies. `public/app.js` sets `emptyState.hidden = tasks.length > 0` each time it loads the list. - **Tests:** I added an SL-008 block to `tests/tasks.test.ts` covering AC-1 to AC-4. - **AC-2:** the same-instant case inserts rows with an identical `created_at` straight into the server's SQLite file, so it is deterministic. A second test checks that creation time wins over id. - **AC-3:** it checks the API response and the page markup and script, not a rendered page, because there is no browser in the test setup. - **AC-4:** it stores 1000 tasks and requests the list 20 times. The p95 is well under 100 ms and the body is far below 400000 bytes. I left `status: planned` in the slice file as it was. The closed SL-002 slice says `done`, but you only asked me to implement and commit. I can flip SL-008 to `done` and update `.sddpp/wbs.md` if you want.
